name: truth-or-dare
description: Premium real-time multiplayer Truth or Dare web application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
